coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping overnight with air conditioner on low
Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and washing face with warm water
Preparing and eating breakfast, toasting bread and boiling water for tea
Getting dressed in work clothes and packing a bag with lunch, notes and work shoes

Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating packed lunch and resting briefly
Continuing physiotherapy work: leading exercise groups, manual therapy and updating patient treatment records
Washing hands and changing out of work clothes
Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
Using the computer to complete continuing professional development modules on physiotherapy techniques
Relaxing on the sofa watching television
Taking an evening shower and completing night-time grooming routine
Wind-down in bed: checking the phone briefly and setting an alarm for the next day
